description:
Returns project entitlements for a Funding Source. Response is paginated and each item includes project details.
Requires the `view_project_entitlements` granular permission on the Funding Sources tool.

parameters.name: funding_source_id
parameters.description: Unique string identifier of the funding source. Use in project-entitlement and project-usage paths under `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/funding_sources/{funding_source_id}/`.

parameters.name: filters[project_id][]
parameters.description: Filter to specific project IDs. Prefer the repeatable array form, e.g. `filters[project_id][]=100&filters[project_id][]=101`. A single scalar ID (`filters[project_id]=100`) and a JSON array string ...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending.

data.description: Project entitlements for the funding source — each an allocation of funds to one project. Ordered per the `sort` query parameter.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the entitlement. Show and update are addressed by the composite `{funding_source_id}`/`{project_id}` path rather than by this id.

project.description: Project receiving the allocation. Use nested `id` as `{project_id}` on show and update.

allocation_balance.description: Amount of the funding source allocated to this project in the funding source's currency. Always non-negative. Returned with exactly 2 fractional digits.

version.description: Monotonic version counter used for optimistic locking. Pass the latest value back on update to detect concurrent modifications.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the entitlement was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the entitlement was last updated.

currency_configuration.description: Currency of this entitlement. Inherited from the parent funding source; use to interpret `allocation_balance`.

project_entitlement.description: Entitlement summary. Present on project-usage list items when `include=project_entitlement` is requested.

balances.description: Project-scoped balance breakdown. Present only when `include=balances` is requested. Amounts are returned with exactly 2 fractional digits.
